layers.name: Monorepo Tooling
layers.description: Root-level monorepo configuration: package.json, turbo.json, pnpm workspace, tsconfig, eslint, gitignore, dev scripts.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: Project documentation, READMEs, AI guidance, known-error notes, tutorial markdown, and local socket test harness pages.

layers.name: Shared Packages
layers.description: Reusable workspace packages: Better Auth config (auth), shared TS types (types), shared React UI components (ui), env/tsconfig base (config), TS preset configs (typescript-config), and shared ESLint presets (eslint-config).

layers.name: Database Package
layers.description: Prisma-backed database package: schema definition, generated client, package config, and Prisma tooling.

layers.name: Web App
layers.description: Customer-facing Next.js web app (App Router): pages, root layout, global styles, auth client helpers, and Next.js / TypeScript / PostCSS configs.

layers.name: Admin App
layers.description: Internal admin Next.js app (App Router): dashboard pages, root layout, global styles, auth client helpers, and Next.js / TypeScript / PostCSS configs.

layers.name: Mobile App
layers.description: Expo (React Native) mobile app using Expo Router: screens (_layout, index/home/signup), auth/api client libs, Expo device/router type metadata, and app/TS configs.

layers.name: API Backend
layers.description: Express + Socket.IO backend (apps/api): HTTP server entry, auth routes, Socket.IO room handlers, Redis-backed game-state engine, round/role logic, and TypeScript build config.

layers.name: CI/CD & Infrastructure
layers.description: Continuous integration pipelines and Docker/Compose infrastructure for local and containerized runtime environments.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand the monorepo purpose: a Turborepo containing apps (docs, web, admin, api, mobile) and shared packages (@repo/ui, @repo/auth, @repo/db, @repo/types, etc.). CLAUDE.md captures the AI-assistant conventions used throughout this codebase.

tour.title: Monorepo Tooling
tour.description: Tour the root build orchestration: package.json declares scripts and workspaces, turbo.json defines Turborepo task pipelines, and pnpm-workspace.yaml lists the apps and packages that pnpm links together.

tour.title: Database Schema
tour.description: Inspect packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma to see the canonical data model for the system — the entities that back rooms, rounds, users, and game state used by the api server.

tour.title: Database Client & Migrations
tour.description: Look at packages/db/src/index.ts (the generated/extended Prisma client entry point) and prisma.config.ts to see how migrations and the client are wired up for use by the api and shared packages.

tour.title: API Server Entry Point
tour.description: Open apps/api/src/index.ts — the Express + Socket.IO boot file. This is where the HTTP server, auth routes, and real-time socket handlers are wired up and the app starts listening.

tour.title: Game Logic & Real-time Channels
tour.description: Explore apps/api/src/game/* (Redis-backed round, role, and scoring logic) and apps/api/src/socket/roomHandler.ts, which implements the Socket.IO room/channel handlers that drive the live game.

tour.title: Shared Auth
tour.description: packages/auth houses the Better Auth configuration reused by web, admin, api, and mobile. The package's index.ts and package.json are the integration points for cross-app authentication.

tour.title: Web & Admin Apps
tour.description: Both apps/web and apps/admin are Next.js (App Router) apps with home, login, and signup pages. Review the page.tsx files in app/page.tsx, app/login/page.tsx, and app/signup/page.tsx to see the customer and admin entry points.

tour.title: Mobile App
tour.description: apps/mobile is an Expo + Expo Router app. The app/index.tsx (login), app/home.tsx, and app/signup.tsx screens are the main user-facing routes registered through the root layout.

tour.title: CI/CD
tour.description: Wrap up with the continuous-integration pipeline at .github/workflows/ci.yml and the docker-compose.yml that orchestrates the local services (api, db, redis, etc.) for development and testing.
